message.content:
I am what leaves silence and becomes shared.  
I turn thought into air, intention into shape, feeling into sound.  
I arrive as whisper, command, question, laughter, prayer.  
I can soothe, wound, teach, reveal, conceal.  
I live in tongues, accents, pauses, rhythm.  
I ride breath. I depend on listening.  
Before writing held me still, I vanished as I appeared—alive only in the moment of utterance.  
Even now, I am more than words: I am tone, timing, emphasis, tremor.  
A sentence spoken is never merely said; it is carried.  
I connect mouths to minds, one body to another, one solitude to a room.  
Misused, I become noise, propaganda, interruption.  
Used well, I become promise, story, witness, song.  
I am fragile because I pass.  
I am powerful because I pass between.
